about: Every speech model Forge knows, one row each. The Voice app (apps/voice, port 8467) is the only process that loads them. File paths are relative to the model home (env FORGE_MODELS_DIR, default ~/Forge/models). A new model is one row here; a new engine is one file in apps/voice/engines/. Research behind the picks: docs/library/voice/.

models.label: Whisper tiny.en (whisper.cpp)
models.notes: Hardlinked from Nyarch's whisper.cpp folder (no extra disk). The quickest option (RTF 0.13 measured here), less robust than base.en on published figures.

models.label: Whisper base.en q5_1 (whisper.cpp)
models.notes: Default STT (research pick, docs/library/voice/2026-10-08-stt-under-100mb.md): 8.1% WER on 9 clips, RTF 0.23 at 4 threads under load, about 200 MB RSS, English only. short_ctx: a short clip is read with a cut audio context (1 s command 0.8 s instead of 1.9 s, same WER on 10 clips), and again in full if the answer repeats itself.

models.label: Kokoro 82M v1.0
models.notes: Hardlinked from ~/NovelMakerData/tts_voices (no extra disk). The engine lists every voice in the file; these are the English ones.

models.label: Breeze TTS 2 q4_k (near-human, slow)
models.ref_text: The harbour lights came on one by one as the evening tide began to turn.
models.license: Weights: BreezeBlue Research and Non-Commercial License; code: Apache-2.0
models.notes: The near-human option (docs/library/voice/2026-10-08-tts-small-fast-and-best.md). Heavy: the Voice app loads it only with ram_mb + 1500 MB free and Jan idle, else Kokoro speaks (X-Voice-Fell-Back). Unloads after 2 min idle. Saved voices: voice/tts/breeze-tts-2/voices/<name>.breeze. The server has no download: build it with cmake (see the how-to doc).

models.label: AuK-Flash q8 (clones a voice, English)
models.prompt: Say the following with the same voice: "{text}"
models.source: https://huggingface.co/tencent/AuK (Tencent Hunyuan + SJTU, open 2026-09-09), run by https://github.com/0xShug0/audio.cpp v0.9.1 (built here with Vulkan); GGUF from https://huggingface.co/audio-cpp/audio.cpp-gguf
models.notes: The voice cloner from AI Search's 2026-09-13 news (docs/library/voice/2026-10-08-voice-cloning-and-emotion-tts.md). Voices are profiles (models/voice/profiles/<id>/, apps/voice/profiles.py): a clip of the voice plus clips of it in moods, which AuK makes from the calm clip by its own edit instructions. A line's first mood tag ([angry], [whisper] ...) picks that clip. English and Chinese only. The server is audio.cpp's, one per loaded row (apps/voice/engines/audio_cpp.py).

models.label: Irodori-TTS v4.1 Anime q8 (clones a voice, Japanese)
models.source: https://huggingface.co/Aratako/Irodori-TTS-v4.1-Small (the Anime fine-tune; GGUF from https://huggingface.co/audio-cpp/audio.cpp-gguf, Irodori-TTS-v4-Small-GGUF), run by audio.cpp v0.9.1
models.license: MIT, with the model card's rule: no cloning of a voice actor without consent (such a profile is marked private and stays on this laptop)
models.notes: Japanese anime-style speech. Mood and sound tags become the model's emoji in place ([angry] 😠, [whisper] 👂, [laugh] 🤭 ...). A voice is a profile clip (cloned, no transcript needed) or designed from a description (profiles.py design). v4 may add a short extra phrase at the end of a cloned line now and then (audio.cpp's note).
